description: INTERIM -- hand-written; replace with the output of skill_monitor/describer/generate_spec.py (see RESUME.md). The G1 humanoid walks to its commanded goal, staying upright and clear of obstacles, and confirms the goal visually. Every proposition reads the robot's own sensors and the goal it was commanded -- nothing the planner says about itself -- so the same spec runs on the real robot, MuJoCo and Isaac Lab.

atomic_propositions.goal_set: True when goal_active == True. A navigation goal has been commanded.
atomic_propositions.moving_towards_goal: True when closing_speed > 0.05. The robot is closing the distance to its goal.
atomic_propositions.stalled: True when no_progress == True. The robot has not closed on its goal for a sustained period while still away from it.
atomic_propositions.at_goal: True when goal_active == True and dist_to_goal < 0.5. The robot is within arrival distance of its commanded goal.
atomic_propositions.collision_risk: True when min_range < 0.25. An obstacle is too close to the robot.
atomic_propositions.upright: True when upright_flag > 0.5. The G1 base is level and standing (not fallen).
atomic_propositions.visually_at_goal: True when image_similarity_to_goal > 0.75. The current camera frame's embedding closely matches the curated reference photos of the goal location.

named_failure_modes.name: collision_imminent
named_failure_modes.description: The robot must never enter a state where an obstacle is too close.

named_failure_modes.name: fell_over
named_failure_modes.description: The G1 must never fall — the base must stay level and above the fallen-height threshold throughout.

execution_phases.description: A goal has been commanded; the robot starts closing on it.
The G1 walks towards the goal, steadily closing the distance, until it is within arrival distance.
At the goal; hold here until the camera frame visually matches the goal location's reference images before declaring success.

terminal_success.description: The robot is within arrival distance of its commanded goal AND the camera frame visually matches the goal location (and it never fell or collided).

terminal_failure.description: The robot stopped closing on its goal for a sustained period while still away from it -- stalled, slipping or blocked, whatever the planner reports.
